{{Quote|You still live at home, I didn't expect that.''"<br />"''I move around so much, I've never had the time to even begin to find a place of my own, and I'm not sure I want to. Official residences have no warmth. Not like here. I feel good here. I feel at home.|Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala|<ref name="AOTC novel" />}}
The '''Naberrie family home''' was the residence of [[Naberrie family/Legends|House Naberrie]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

==Description==
{{Quote|There's my house!|Padmé Amidala, pointing out her house to Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="AOTC novel" />}}
The home of [[Naberrie family/Legends|House Naberrie]] was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Theed/Legends|Theed]].<ref name="Fact84" />

==History==
The house was built [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before the end of the [[Great Peace of the Republic]],<ref name="Date" /> and was present for numerous generations of [[Naboo (people)|Naboo]].<ref name="Fact84" /> Following the [[Reproduction/Legends|birth]] of their daughter [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé]] in [[46 BBY/Legends|46 BBY]]<ref name="Date" /> the [[Marriage/Legends|married]] couple [[Ruwee Naberrie/Legends|Ruwee]] and [[Jobal Naberrie/Legends|Jobal Naberrie]] chose to move from their [[Unidentified Naboo mountain village (Padmé Amidala)/Legends|mountain village]] home to the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] to provide greater opportunities for Padmé and their older daughter [[Sola Naberrie/Legends|Sola Naberrie]]. Ruwee selected the house for his family, partly because he admired its design.<ref name="Fact84" />
